title: Accordion Pleat (8ths)
description: Seven parallel creases alternating mountain and valley. The simplest tessellation and the building block of every pleated design.

steps.title: Fold in half, left edge to right edge
steps.text: Fold in half, left edge to right edge. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold the left edge to the centre line
steps.text: Fold the left edge to the centre line. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold the right edge to the centre line
steps.text: Fold the right edge to the centre line. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold the left edge to the 1/4 line
steps.text: Fold the left edge to the 1/4 line. Mountain fold (away from you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold the left edge to the 3/4 line
steps.text: Fold the left edge to the 3/4 line. Mountain fold (away from you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold the right edge to the 1/4 line
steps.text: Fold the right edge to the 1/4 line. Mountain fold (away from you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold the right edge to the 3/4 line
steps.text: Fold the right edge to the 3/4 line. Mountain fold (away from you), then unfold.

steps.title: Collapse along the existing creases
steps.text: Collapse along the existing creases: re-fold every valley toward you and every mountain away from you at the same time, then flatten.
